methods.title: Exact owner refspec recovery
methods.failure_signature: A single-branch clone cannot resolve a newly pushed owner branch through a remote-tracking ref until its exact fetch refspec is present.
trigger_preconditions: new owner branch pushed from a single-branch clone
methods.candidate_workaround: Add and fetch the exact owner branch refspec, then bind upstream.
methods.recurrence_guard: Check remote.origin.fetch before the first four-way equality probe in a rotated independent clone.
methods.rollback: Remove only the exact added refspec if it is incorrect; never rewrite a commit.
methods.scope_boundary: Local Git metadata recovery only; no source or sibling mutation.

methods.title: Raw Git-blob planning manifest
methods.failure_signature: Working-tree byte hashes can differ from committed blobs under line-ending normalization.
methods.candidate_workaround: Hash raw git show bytes for every exact planning-delta path and publish an additive manifest.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use raw Git blobs for all post-commit manifests; label working-byte manifests as precommit only.
methods.rollback: Retain both manifests and remove neither historical record.
methods.scope_boundary: Planning-commit byte evidence only; no domain or scientific promotion.
